open_points.subject: paging table selection between store and store_persistence
open_points.text: `store` ... keeps ... "which table a page reads for its record type"; `store_persistence` "Must not own ... which table a page reads" while it owns "one table per record type" and hides SQLite table creation
open_points.question: Does `store` select only the typed record type while `store_persistence` maps that type to its physical SQLite table, or must `store` select the physical table despite the repository hiding tables and accepting no table name?
options: `store` selects the record type; `store_persistence` owns the record-type-to-table lowering
`store` owns physical table selection and the repository must expose a typed way to convey it
open_points.default_guess: Treat `store` as owning the semantic record-type choice and `store_persistence` as owning its physical table mapping.
